name: images_segment
description: Produces a black/white MASK of one thing in an image with SAM 3.1: describe it in `prompt` ("the red car", "her hair") and/or mark it with `points`/`boxes` in 0..1 coordinates. The result is the `maskCreationIdentifier` that `images_retouch` needs, so this is the step BEFORE a targeted replace/erase. Returns immediately (no wait needed). To cut the subject out of its background instead, use `images_remove_background`.

label.description: 1 = this is part of the thing, 0 = this is NOT part of it.

prompt.description: What to segment, in plain words ("the dog", "the sky"). Optional when points or boxes are given.
